text:
Amanda (CS): Heads-up — AcmeBank renewal demo in 7 days. They're worried about latency spikes during live demos. I drafted a short customer-facing ops checklist covering warmup, caching/batching, streaming fallbacks, and quick feedback capture. Need eng/sre/solutions sign-off before tomorrow.

Raj (Eng): Quick plan: 1) prefill tenant KV with common prompts 10m before demos, 2) enable a short-lived warm pool sized for the demo window, 3) configure a higher-throughput fallback model. Prefill example:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"acmebank-prod","prompts":["account summary","last 5 transactions"]}'
```
Run ~10m pre-demo.

Amanda (CS): They expect ~200 concurrent demo flows at peak. Does that change sizing? :thinking_face:

Raj (Eng): For 200 concurrent: request dedicated reserved capacity for the 30-min demo window or you'll get queueing. Set warm_pool_size ~6 per shard, batch_target 8. YAML snippet to hand them:```yaml
service: redwood-runtime
warm_pool: 6
batch_target: 8
fallback_model: llm-small-quant
```
This keeps p99 stable.

Mike (SRE): Monitoring notes: create short-lived alerts for queue_depth > 50 and p95_latency > 800ms for the demo window. Enable request-level tracing for the tenant. Example alert:```text
- name: AcmeBank Demo Latency
  expr: p95_latency{tenant=\"acmebank-prod\"} > 0.8
  for: 2m
  labels: {severity: \"high\"}
```
Bump autoscale max to x2 for the window and ensure fallback policy is active.

Julia (Solutions): From enablement: run a 30-min smoke 24h before renewal call: 1) validate request shapes (short vs long sequences), 2) collect 10 sample prompts per demo flow, 3) confirm prefill permission. I'll send a one-click checklist to ops and a two-question survey (latency ok? Y/N; output issues? free text). We'll capture responses into the account ticket.

Amanda (CS): Action items: @Raj run prefill script 10m prior & verify KV hits; @Mike add alerts + increase autoscale; @Julia run smoke and send survey. I'll coordinate times with AcmeBank PM.

Raj (Eng): Confirmed. Doing a staging dry-run now and will paste results.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: ramped-warm-pool-fix -> staging (id: d-3387). ETA 3m.

Mike (SRE): Staging dry-run shows KV cache hit rate from 3% -> 78% after prefill. Logs:```text
[2026-03-22T14:05:12Z] tenant=acmebank-prod cache_hit=true latency=120ms
[2026-03-22T14:05:13Z] tenant=acmebank-prod cache_hit=true latency=110ms
```
I'll monitor p95 during the demo and escalate if thresholds breached.

Julia (Solutions): Sending smoke checklist + survey link to customer now. Template: "Please run your demo flow and paste 3 example prompts here."

Amanda (CS): Great. Setting renewal risk = Medium in account tracker and scheduling 24h smoke + 10m prefill before demo. Post-demo we'll review survey + telemetry and recommend dedicated capacity if needed. :thumbsup: 

Raj (Eng): FYI: if fallback_model causes quality drop, we have gradual rollback routing (small percent to main model) while triaging. I'll add to runbook.

Mike (SRE): I'll add runbook steps for on-call: trigger fallback, manual scale, and trace locations.

Amanda (CS): Thanks team. I'll log results in the renewal thread after the smoke. Closing this thread after smoke completes.
